title: Tasty Additions
description: Tasty Additions gives Minecraft's food a boost with new stuff to cook, meals to make, and ways to process it all.
body:
## 🍞 Tasty Additions

Tasty Additions expands Minecraft’s food system with new ingredients, meals, and simple processing mechanics — all designed to feel right at home in vanilla Minecraft.

The mod adds new foods, desserts, and processing blocks that integrate naturally into survival gameplay without unnecessary complexity or overpowered items.

**🍽️ Features:**
- New vanilla-style food items
- Desserts and sweet treats, including ice cream
- Food processing blocks like the Ice Cream Maker
- Balanced recipes and progression
- Custom textures and GUIs matching the vanilla style
  
**⚙️ Vanilla-Friendly & Multiplayer Ready:**

 Tasty Additions focuses on simplicity and balance, making it a great fit for:
> - Survival worlds
> - Multiplayer servers
> - Vanilla-focused modpacks
  
The mod works in singleplayer and multiplayer and must be installed on both client and server.

**🚧 Ongoing Development**

Tasty Additions is actively developed and will continue to receive updates with new food content and improvements.
